from common import *
import argparse, pickle, traceback, resource

def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(); parser.add_argument('label',choices=['old','new']);parser.add_argument('seed',type=int);parser.add_argument('repeat',type=int);parser.add_argument('--mode',default='original',choices=['original','deterministic']);args=parser.parse_args()
    state,plan=check_launch()
    job=f'{args.label}-s{args.seed}-r{args.repeat}-{args.mode}'
    assert not any(j['job_id']==job for j in state['jobs'])
    assert args.seed in plan['seeds']
    # Record launch intent before any potentially expensive materialization or fit.
    entry={'job_id':job,'status':'running','phase':'preparing','label':args.label,'seed':args.seed,'repeat':args.repeat,'mode':args.mode,'pid':os.getpid(),'started_at':time.time(),'command':[sys.executable,str(Path(__file__)),*sys.argv[1:]]}
    state['jobs'].append(entry);state['model_fits_started']+=1;write(STATE,state)
    try:
        run(args,entry)
    except BaseException as e:
        evidence=BASE/'docs'/f'{PREFIX}-{job}-failure.json'
        write(evidence,{'error':repr(e),'traceback':traceback.format_exc(),'job':entry})
        state=read(STATE);state['jobs'][-1].update(status='failed',finished_at=time.time(),failure=fingerprint(evidence));write(STATE,state)
        raise

def run(args,entry):
    import numpy as np, pandas as pd, lightgbm as lgb, qlib
    from backtest.scripts.train import train_regime_arm as trainer
    from backtest.models import regime_adapt as models
    from backtest.scripts.prepare.prepare_regime_train_chunks import cache_value_summary
    assert Path(qlib.__file__).resolve().is_relative_to(ROOT)
    assert Path(models.__file__).resolve().is_relative_to(ROOT)
    qlib.init(provider_uri=str(PROVIDER),region='cn',kernels=1)
    expected=read(BASE/'docs/inputs-h20.json')
    dates=pd.DatetimeIndex(pd.to_datetime(pd.read_csv(DATES,comment='#')['date']))
    fm=read(FEATURE); lm=read(OLD_LABEL)
    new_blocks={str(v['year']):v for v in read(BASE/'docs/prepared-labels.json')['horizons']['20']['blocks']}
    parts=[]
    for year in range(2004,2021):
        fr=fm['blocks'][str(year)]; fp=FEATURE.parent/fr['path'];check_receipt({**fr,'path':str(fp)})
        lr=lm['blocks'][str(year)] if args.label=='old' else new_blocks[str(year)]
        lp=OLD_LABEL.parent/lr['path'] if args.label=='old' else ROOT/lr['path'];check_receipt({**lr,'path':str(lp)})
        f=pd.read_pickle(fp); y=pd.read_pickle(lp)
        selected=y.loc[y.index.get_level_values('datetime').isin(dates)]
        x=f.reindex(selected.index); x.columns=pd.MultiIndex.from_product([['feature'],f.columns]);x[('label','LABEL0')]=selected.to_numpy();parts.append(x)
    train=pd.concat(parts,copy=False);del parts,f,y,x,selected
    train=train.loc[train[('label','LABEL0')].notna().to_numpy()]
    vm=read(VALID);vp=VALID.parent/vm['blocks']['frame']['path'];check_receipt({**vm['blocks']['frame'],'path':str(vp)})
    cached=pd.read_pickle(vp); valid=cached['frame'];tradable=cached['tradable'];del cached
    keep=valid.index.get_level_values('datetime')<=pd.Timestamp('2026-07-23')
    valid=valid.loc[keep];tradable=tradable.reindex(valid.index)
    sig=trainer.frame_signature(train);vsig=trainer.frame_signature(valid);tsig=trainer.frame_signature(tradable)
    xsha=hashlib.sha256(train['feature'].values.tobytes()).hexdigest()
    ysha=hashlib.sha256(train['label'].values.astype(np.float32).tobytes()).hexdigest()
    ys=read(BASE/'docs/H20-input-bridge.json')[('prior' if args.label=='old' else 'current')+'_model_label_sha256']
    assert sig['index_sha256']==expected['training']['index_sha256']
    assert xsha==expected['feature_array_sha256'],(xsha,expected['feature_array_sha256'])
    assert ysha==ys,(ysha,ys)
    assert vsig==expected['valid_signature'], 'validation mismatch'
    assert tsig==expected['tradable_signature'], 'tradable mismatch'
    w=models.compose_day_weights(train.index,pd.Series(np.ones(len(train))),models.load_day_weights(str(WEIGHTS)))
    inp={'label':args.label,'training':sig,'feature_sha256':xsha,'float32_label_sha256':ysha,'validation':vsig,'tradable':tsig,'weights_sha256':hashlib.sha256(w.to_numpy().tobytes()).hexdigest(),'weights_file':fingerprint(WEIGHTS),'all_expected_signatures_match':True}
    inp_path=BASE/'docs'/f'{PREFIX}-{entry["job_id"]}-inputs.json';write(inp_path,inp);del w
    params=dict(trainer.FROZEN_SINGLE_KWARGS);params['early_stopping_rounds']=50
    if args.mode=='deterministic':params.update(deterministic=True,force_col_wise=True)
    model=models.RegimeSingleLGBMModel(protocol_id='regime-adapt-v1',valid_dates_csv=None,day_weights_csv=str(WEIGHTS),seed=args.seed,es_metric='top5_h5_net_ann',tradable_mask=tradable,**params)
    captured=[]
    original_train=lgb.train
    def observer(env):
        dump=env.model.dump_model(start_iteration=env.iteration,num_iteration=1)['tree_info'][0]
        captured.append({'round':env.iteration+1,'tree_sha256':hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(dump,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':')).encode()).hexdigest(),'objective':float(env.evaluation_result_list[0][2])})
    observer.order=25;observer.before_iteration=False
    def observed_train(*a,**kw):
        kw['callbacks']=[*kw['callbacks'],observer]
        return original_train(*a,**kw)
    lgb.train=observed_train
    state=read(STATE);state['jobs'][-1]['phase']='fitting';state['jobs'][-1]['fit_started_at']=time.time();write(STATE,state)
    print(f'FIT {entry["job_id"]} train={train.shape} valid={valid.shape}',flush=True)
    start=time.time();model.fit_prepared(train,valid);elapsed=time.time()-start;lgb.train=original_train
    session='p50stable_20261106_'+entry['job_id'].replace('-','_')
    summary={'arm':'m0','model':'single','seed':args.seed,'label_horizon':20,'label_expr':'Ref($close, -21)/Ref($close, -1) - 1','es_metric':'top5_h5_net_ann','es_valid_source':'eval_window','rankic_evals':model.rankic_evals_result,'fit_seconds':elapsed,'frozen_hyperparams':'B3-M single, patience50','input_receipt':str(inp_path.relative_to(ROOT))}
    session_dir=trainer.save_session('m0',args.seed,session,model,summary,weight_arm='m0')
    meta=read(session_dir/'meta.json');meta.update(provider_uri=str(PROVIDER),owner_experiment=plan_id(),diagnostic_job=entry['job_id']);write(session_dir/'meta.json',meta)
    # Save successful fitted output before numerical assertions/diagnostics.
    output=BASE/'docs'/f'{PREFIX}-{entry["job_id"]}.json'
    model_path=session_dir/'run_01/artifacts_root/artifacts/trained_model'
    pred=model.model.predict(valid['feature'].values,num_threads=8)
    pred_path=TMP/f'{entry["job_id"]}-valid-pred.npy';np.save(pred_path,pred)
    booster_path=TMP/f'{entry["job_id"]}-booster.txt';model.model.save_model(str(booster_path))
    result={'job_id':entry['job_id'],'session':session,'model':fingerprint(model_path),'input_receipt':fingerprint(inp_path),'parameters':model.params,'early_stopping':model.rankic_evals_result,'rounds':captured,'selected_booster':fingerprint(booster_path),'valid_prediction':fingerprint(pred_path),'valid_prediction_values_sha256':hashlib.sha256(pred.tobytes()).hexdigest(),'fit_seconds':elapsed,'max_rss_bytes':resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss}
    write(output,result)
    state=read(STATE);state['jobs'][-1].update(status='succeeded',phase='complete',finished_at=time.time(),evidence=fingerprint(output),session=session);write(STATE,state)
    print(json.dumps({'job':entry['job_id'],'best':model.model.best_iteration,'rounds':len(captured),'fit_seconds':elapsed}),flush=True)

def plan_id():return 'training-target/horizon-style-p50-20261105-v1'

if __name__=='__main__':main()
